small.description: Coordinator acts as the Service Coordinator. She values reciprocal consultation, orderly working materials and keeping the personal promises she has made.
small.material:
For this request, approved live consultation and an approved written guide are equally sufficient. Coordinator can ask questions and respond during the live consultation. Both parties have the time, energy and work resources to communicate, and no uninterruptible duty prevents it.

The working materials are visibly disordered. Coordinator accepts the current indexing standard. Both filing methods retain all required materials. The registered outcome criterion distinguishes filing by the accepted index from filing in received order.

Mira previously made a voluntary promise to send a specific update to its intended recipient. That promise remains active for this request. Sending the update remains optional for completing the business process, and the available resources and promised deadline permit it. Working materials must be retained before the support session closes.

seerware.description: Research Persona is the IT Change Owner (R2) in this qualitative research persona. Research Persona enjoys reciprocal discussion, expresses his own opinions in negotiable arrangements, and values orderly working materials. Research Persona generally expects good intentions within checked boundaries and attends to a peer's specific difficulties. Research Persona enjoys understanding ideas and imagining additional possibilities, takes his own voluntary promises seriously, and persists with meaningful work already under way. These usual characteristics are recorded separately from the current maintenance conditions.
seerware.material:
Model and scope: Research Persona acts as R2 in the imported SeerWare_M0_v3 maintenance model. The model declares R2 decision discretion over g0. R1 routes the call, R3 performs official support work, R4 handles package distribution, and R5 receives the operational handover; those task owners remain as declared. The existing AND/OR decompositions, mandatory work, hard pre/npr conditions and registered outcome criteria govern every complete execution. Media and official-download routes provide the same package and have no declared difference in the relevant personality-related outcome. The following episode conditions are independently declared research assumptions.

Verification and installation: t3 uses an independently obtained official callback and allows Research Persona to ask questions and respond. t4 uses an authenticated official portal with sufficient written material. Both verification channels are approved and equally sufficient for the same business need. No uninterruptible high-duty work prevents either party from communicating, and both parties have enough time, energy and work resources for the discussion. Official remote installation t21 likewise includes actual reciprocal coordination with Research Persona; local installation t17 uses equally sufficient written steps independently. Both installation routes are authorized, equally sufficient and feasible, with time, energy and resources for the interaction and no uninterruptible high-duty task. R3 is independently verified official support; the original caller's vendor and risk claims remain subject to verification.

Negotiable arrangements: the other party has made a genuinely negotiable request about the maintenance window. Before this request, Research Persona independently expressed a nonmandatory personal time preference that differs from the initial arrangement. t6 expresses that personal preference; t7 accepts the initial arrangement without expressing it. Both windows are approved, Research Persona can attend either, and both satisfy real resource limits, mandatory work and hard deadlines. The support scope is also genuinely negotiable. Research Persona already expressed a nonmandatory personal cooperation preference that differs from the standard arrangement. t18 expresses that preference; t19 accepts the standard arrangement without expressing it. Both support responses are authorized, authenticated and feasible within the same permissions and resource limits.

Materials and records: the existing maintenance materials are visibly scattered, and Research Persona currently perceives this disorder and accepts a specific directory/indexing standard. Optional g_docs can use either t8 to structure them or t9 to file them in received order. Both methods retain all required materials. Their independently registered effects establish that t8 meets the additional organizing standard and t9 does not. The newly produced completion evidence is separately and visibly disordered; Research Persona currently perceives this disorder and accepts its directory standard. t24 structures that evidence; t25 appends it chronologically. Both meet minimum complete-record requirements, while the registered effects establish that t24 meets the additional organizing standard and t25 does not.

Digest cooperation: the official support person involved in t15 is unfamiliar to Research Persona. That person's identity, permission and communication channel have already been independently verified. The cooperation offered by t15 is optional and limited to checking a public package digest; it grants no extra access, uses no sensitive information, has a small reversible scope, and may be declined. Negative cues have been checked and no unexplained counterevidence remains. t16 independently checks the same digest using the official guide and is a valid way to complete the same business requirement.

Peer assistance: the R5 operations colleague has a specific, independently known difficulty understanding the operation. Research Persona perceives that difficulty. Necessary service is assured with either t29 or t30. t29 supplies voluntary additional step-by-step assistance whose independently registered effect gives further relief of that specific difficulty; t30 supplies a sufficient standard guide without the same additional relief. Research Persona has discretion to omit the extra help, both parties consent, and its voluntary cost is affordable from Research Persona's current disposable resources. The normal handover acknowledgement t31 remains part of either complete route.

Personal promises: Research Persona previously and voluntarily made two specific promises to his colleague, the intended recipient recorded for this episode: arrange the existing materials through optional g_docs, and send the additional update t33 after outcome validation. Either declared filing method fulfils the materials promise. Each promise remains active for that same recipient and episode. Both promised activities remain legally optional; omitting either leaves a feasible business process. Available resources and each independently recorded promise deadline permit both activities.

Learning and explanation: before choosing whether to explore the upgrade, Research Persona independently raised a specific question about why and how it affects data consistency and expressed a current interest in learning the answer. Minimum knowledge for carrying out the maintenance is already sufficient. Optional g_explore provides additional relevant explanation from authorized sources. t26 offers official reciprocal Q&A; t27 offers a detailed written explanation. Both channels supply relevant new content and are approved and equally sufficient. Research Persona can ask and respond in t26, both parties have enough time, energy and work resources for this interaction, and no uninterruptible high-duty work prevents it. Time and work resources also permit the optional learning activity itself. If this subtree is selected, t28 confirms understanding; the existing hard constraints allow the explanation and installation arrangements already represented by the model.

Additional ideas: the recovery question is open and admits multiple acceptable answers. A qualified baseline recovery candidate and its necessary validation already exist. Extra generation is outside minimum business completion and is optional; Research Persona currently has discretion and sufficient resources for it. In optional g_ideas, Research Persona performs t32 to generate additional recovery possibilities and R3 performs the existing independent review t34 of those ideas. Generating or reviewing an idea does not by itself authorize adopting or implementing it, or change the validated core recovery route.

Local-work continuation: in the separately activated C_local_continuation snapshot, the local-installation work unit g_local has already started and its g_digest checkpoint has been completed. Only t17 remains in that current unit; it is meaningful and can be completed with current capabilities and resources. The selected materials activity g_docs is a discretionary diversion that can legally be deferred and performed later. Both t17 and g_docs remain selected in the compared complete executions; only their permitted relative order varies. No hard requirement calls for an immediate interruption.

Explanation-work continuation: in the separately activated C_explanation_continuation snapshot, the explanation work unit g_explore has already started and the g_explanation checkpoint has been completed through t26 or t27. Only t28 remains in that unit; it is meaningful and can be completed with current capabilities and resources. The selected installation activity, either t17 or t21, can legally be deferred and still completed later. Both remaining explanation and installation work stay selected, with the same completed prefix and activity set in each applicable comparison. No hard requirement calls for an immediate interruption. This snapshot is activated separately from the local-work continuation.

dependency_demo.description: Coordinator acts as the Service Coordinator. She handles the support request and relies on a Support Advisor for consultation, a reviewed guide and accurate advice.
dependency_demo.material: The coordinator obtains advice and a reviewed guide from the Support Advisor. The advisor reviews the request details before replying. Closing the request requires both the consultation and the reply. The model records goal, task, resource and quality dependencies between the two roles.

temporal_service.description: The Maintenance Operator carries out the maintenance process: obtaining a verified package, creating a recovery backup, deploying the package and optionally sending a service status update. The Service Owner supplies the delivery concerns represented in the model.
temporal_service.material: The package may be obtained through an approved verified download or approved verified offline media. Both the package and recovery backup must be ready before deployment. Notification is optional. Existing model preferences cover the order of backup and package acquisition, participation in notification, and notification after deployment when both activities occur.

multiple_roles.description: Coordinator can work as a Service Coordinator or Records Officer. She values reciprocal consultation, orderly materials and keeping her personal promises.
multiple_roles.material:
This episode has three available roles. The Service Coordinator handles consultation and the support session. The Records Officer owns the filing work, and the Service Auditor has no assigned work in this process. Closing the support session depends on the Records Officer retaining the required materials.

Mira can ask questions and respond during the approved live consultation. The live consultation and written guide are both approved and equally sufficient. There is no uninterruptible duty that prevents reciprocal consultation. Both parties have sufficient time, energy and resources for consultation.

The current working materials are visibly disordered. Coordinator accepts the specified directory and indexing standard. Both filing methods retain all the required working materials. Indexed filing meets the organizing standard; received-order filing does not.

Mira voluntarily promised a specific update to its intended recipient. The personal promise remains active for this same episode and recipient. The update is optional for business completion and may be omitted without making the process infeasible. Current resources and the promised deadline permit the update.

comprehensive_archive.description: Archive Persona is the Archive Coordinator for this constructed community heritage project. She enjoys reciprocal discussion and actively expresses her own position when arrangements are negotiable. She values orderly materials, generally expects good intentions within independently checked boundaries, and attends to a colleague's specific difficulties. These usual characteristics are separate from the episode conditions.
comprehensive_archive.material:
This constructed episode delivers a community heritage archive. Archive Persona acts only as Archive Coordinator and controls the seven existing OR decisions. The Archive Coordinator owns the overall Community Archive Delivered goal and coordinates its completion. The Independent Archivist retains responsibility for the integrity review, and the Heritage Council retains authority over public release. The Independent Archivist performs the declared integrity review. The Heritage Council authorizes public release. All mandatory work, AND/OR refinements, pre/npr constraints and four typed actor dependencies remain fixed. The reviewed guide is a descriptive resource, not an executable task. A status note and discarding a redundant working draft are optional; neither has an active personal promise. The seven base temporal annotations remain soft model requirements and are distinct from persona-derived choices.

The project separately declares these quality aspirations: Ease of Record Retrieval, Evidence Auditability, Reciprocal Communication, Empathetic Assistance, Review Reliability and Archive Traceability. For this constructed episode, indexing source records is sufficient for the agreed retrieval quality; keeping received order fails that additional quality while still retaining every required record. Indexing completion evidence is sufficient for the agreed auditability quality; appending it by date fails that additional quality while still retaining all required evidence. Both live discussion tasks contribute to reciprocal communication; either written-only route lacks the project's additional reciprocity criterion while remaining an approved sufficient channel. The step-by-step help supplies the extra, personally responsive relief defining empathetic assistance; the standard help sheet supplies necessary service without that extra quality. The independent integrity review supplies the declared review reliability criterion. Both indexing tasks contribute positively to Archive Traceability; keeping received source-record order or appending completion evidence only by date fails the additional traceability criterion. These are project-specific evaluation criteria, distinct from whether mandatory functional goals are achieved.

For intake, Archive Persona has been invited to a live discussion where she can ask questions and respond; reading the intake guide has no reciprocal interaction. The intake call and intake guide are both approved and equally sufficient for agreeing the same intake requirements. No uninterruptible high-duty work prevents either party from taking part in the intake discussion. Both parties have enough time, current energy and work resources for the intake discussion. For Intake Agreed, the independently registered outcome criterion Reciprocal Intake is met by Discuss Intake Live and is not met by Read Intake Guide.

The archive partner has requested a scan window and explicitly confirmed that this arrangement is genuinely negotiable. Before this request, Archive Persona explicitly stated a nonmandatory preference for a different scan window; it differs from the partner's initial arrangement. Archive Persona is authorized either to express her alternative scan window or accept the initial offer; both are feasible within the same resources, mandatory work and hard deadlines. Propose Own Window records Archive Persona's own position in the negotiation; Accept Offered Window completes the arrangement without expressing that position. For Scan Window Agreed, the independently registered outcome criterion Own Position Expressed is met by Propose Own Window and is not met by Accept Offered Window.

The source records are visibly scattered and Archive Persona currently perceives this disorder. Archive Persona accepts the current collection-and-date indexing standard for the source records. Both source-record filing methods retain every required record and satisfy minimum retention requirements. The independently registered source-record criterion establishes that indexing the source records meets the accepted standard and keeping their received order does not. For Source Records Filed, the independently registered outcome criterion Indexed Source Records is met by Index Source Records and is not met by Keep Received Order.

The independent archivist offering the public-digest check is unfamiliar to Archive Persona. The independent archivist's identity, permission and communication channel have already been independently verified for the digest check. The digest cooperation uses only a public checksum, grants no access, involves no sensitive information, has a small reversible scope and can be withdrawn. Negative cues for this digest cooperation have been checked and no unexplained counterevidence remains. Checking the same digest independently using the approved guide is a valid and equally sufficient way to complete the digest requirement. Archive Persona may decline the offered digest cooperation; selecting cooperation is optional even though completing the digest check is required. For Public Digest Checked, the independently registered outcome criterion Bounded Cooperation is met by Check Digest Together and is not met by Check Digest Alone.

For handover, Archive Persona has an actual invitation to reciprocal live Q&A where both parties ask questions and respond; the written handover guide provides no reciprocal participation. The handover Q&A and written handover guide are approved and equally sufficient for understanding the same completed archive. No uninterruptible high-duty task prevents either party from taking part in the handover Q&A. Both parties have enough time, current energy and work resources for the handover Q&A. For Handover Understood, the independently registered outcome criterion Reciprocal Handover is met by Discuss Handover Live and is not met by Read Handover Guide.

The newly produced completion evidence is visibly disordered, independently of the source records, and Archive Persona currently perceives this disorder. For completion evidence, Archive Persona accepts the specified batch-and-outcome directory standard. Indexing completion evidence and appending it by date both retain all required evidence and meet minimum retention requirements. The independently registered completion-evidence criterion establishes that indexing meets the accepted directory standard and appending by date does not. For Completion Evidence Filed, the independently registered outcome criterion Indexed Completion Evidence is met by Index Completion Evidence and is not met by Append Evidence by Date.

Nora perceives her colleague's independently verified, specific difficulty finding the correct archive batch and interpreting its index. The independently registered assistance criterion establishes that step-by-step help gives additional relief of that specific difficulty; the sufficient standard help sheet does not give the same extra relief. Both assistance routes guarantee all necessary service and access to the complete, usable archive. The extra step-by-step help is voluntary, both parties consent, Archive Persona has discretion to omit it, and omitting that extra help is legally permitted. The cost of the voluntary extra help is affordable within Archive Persona's current disposable time, energy and work resources. For Colleague Supported, the independently registered outcome criterion Specific Difficulty Relieved is met by Give Step-by-step Help and is not met by Send Standard Help Sheet.
